name: Have you identified any residual risks and raised them with risk owners for sign-off?
conditionsText:
Applies when:
- Security controls have been implemented.
- Risks have been reassessed.
- Some level of risk remains.
requirementTitle: Have you identified any residual risks and raised them with risk owners for sign-off?
requirementDescription: After all controls have been implemented, are there any risks that still remain, and have the people responsible formally agreed to accept them?
why: No service is completely risk-free. Even after mitigation, some residual risk usually remains. Secure by Design requires accountability for those remaining risks, meaning appropriate risk owners must understand and formally accept them.
tasks: Have you identified any residual risks and raised them with risk owners for sign-off?
